title: coldenia mexicana var. tomentosa
intro: Coldenia mexicana var. tomentosa, commonly known as Mexican false rosemary, is a plant species native to Mexico that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to help manage stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The bioactive constituents of C. mexicana var. tomentosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's therapeutic actions may also be attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exert a protective effect against oxidative stress.
